title: Energizing Charred Ethiopian Collard Greens Gomen
description: A charred, crunchy, and energizing Ethiopian dish featuring milk chocolate, made in a tagine pot and air fryer, suitable for Buddhist temple gatherings.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped collard greens and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to the air fryer and cook at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Melt the milk chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Stir the melted chocolate into the collard green mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top and serve hot.
